Shopping Cart ({cart.length} items)

{cart.length === 0 ? (
🛒

Your cart is empty

Start Shopping
) : (
{cart.map((item) => (
{item.image}

{item.name}

{item.store}

ETB {(item.price * item.qty).toLocaleString()}

{item.qty}
))}

SubtotalETB {subtotal.toLocaleString()}

{shipping > 0 &&

}

Checkout
)}
); }
